data.name: Kahfara
data.gender_notes: Kahfara is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In the Quran, the Cave Story (Surah Al-Kahf) speaks of a young boy and his elder brother who were entrusted with a treasure. They were tested by the people of their town and chose to remain in a cave, protecting their treasure from being misused. Kahfara can be interpreted as a protector, guardian, or one who safeguards a treasure.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes protection, guardianship, and preservation of valuable things.
data.etymology: Kahfara belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Protector of the Treasure.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kahfara total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

In modern usage across Muslim cultures, Kahfara is chosen for its profound meaning and traditional value.
